title: Geometric regularity over a directed union of subfields
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $(k_i)_{i\in I}$ be a nonempty family of subfields of $k$ which is directed (for $i,j\in I$ there is $l\in I$ with $k_i\cup k_j\subseteq k_l$) and has union $k=\bigcup_ik_i$. Let $A$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] $k$-algebra, regarded as a $k_i$-algebra by restriction along $k_i\subseteq k$. If $A$ is geometrically regular over $k_i$ for every $i\in I$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring], then $A$ is geometrically regular over $k$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 07QG (lemma-geometrically-regular-over-subfields, line 47202) and its proof. The proof as written has a misprint: '$k_i = k \otimes_{k_i} k_i'$' must read '$k' = k\otimes_{k_i}k_i'$' (a finite purely inseparable $k'/k$ descends to a finite purely inseparable $k_i'/k_i$ with $k'\cong k\otimes_{k_i}k_i'$, so $A\otimes_kk'\cong A\otimes_{k_i}k_i'$).

proof.text: Unfold geometric regularity, retain the given Noetherianity of A, and fix a finite purely inseparable field extension E/k in Type (max u w). A field is Noetherian, and a finite-dimensional field extension is a finite-type algebra, so Algebra.FinitePresentation.of_finiteType supplies its finite presentation.

Apply the proved Algebra.exists_subfield_model to obtain i, a commutative (K i)-algebra B in Type (max u w), and e : k ⊗[K i] B ≃ₐ[k] E. This is the finite-presentation/coefficient/quotient descent of the original steps 1–3.

Transport IsField, Module.Finite and IsPurelyInseparable from E to k ⊗[K i] B along e, using MulEquiv.isField, Module.Finite.equiv and AlgEquiv.isPurelyInseparable. Apply Algebra.TensorProduct.finite_purelyInseparable_of_tensorProduct to obtain IsField B, Module.Finite (K i) B and IsPurelyInseparable (K i) B. Equip B with hf.toField, whose ring structure is the existing one.

The chosen universe lets (hgeom i).2 B assert regularity of B ⊗[K i] A. Compose tensor commutation, the inverse of cancelBaseChange (K i) k k A B, tensor congruence with e, and tensor commutation over k to get B ⊗[K i] A ≃+* E ⊗[k] A. Mathlib IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv transfers regularity. This establishes the required clause for every E/k.
